description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rev-list --bisect' functionality. It sets up Git repositories, commits, tags, and performs various tests to verify the bisecting process within Git's revision listing commands.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff-based test for the bisect process, comparing the size of the full revision list with the bisected list and checking if the error is within a specified maximum difference.

methods.name: test_sequence
methods.description: Executes a sequence of tests to verify the correctness and behavior of 'git rev-list --bisect' under different scenarios, including different bisect options and edge cases.
